theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Energy (+0.49%) and Technology (+0.09%) led the market today, while Utilities (-1.41%) and Consumer Discretionary (-1.29%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.53%, defensives -0.95%, and value/cyclicals -0.58% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.49%, Dow -0.77%, Nasdaq -0.69% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -1.11%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX rose 4.64% to 16.46, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold added 0.55% to $4,444.70, crude oil was little changed at $96.50, and bitcoin gained 0.14% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
